verses.text: yasurru rasuulal laahi khattii bimawlidi
yaduumu lanaa bishran yafii khayra mawridi
waqaanii ilaahii kulla durrin bijaahi man
lahud dahra khattii duura laghwin wa mufsidi
muhammadunal mukhtaaru lam yaati misluhu
wa laysa yajii mislun lahu nihma sayyidii
maraamii minal mawlaa atanii bilaa azan
bijaahi shafiihil haalamiina muhammadi
wasiqtu birabbil harshi habdan lahu bihi
wa maa zaala qalbi bir ridaa zaa taqayyudi
likhayril baraayaa  min qilaamii bushaaratun
wa lii qaada takhsiisan bihin nafsu tahtadii
dahaanii ilaa ihyaa-i zash shahri kawnuhu
likhayril waraa zarfan hawaa kulla suudadi
hadiyyaatunaa tasfuu ladal laahi sarmadan
wa hanaa mahaa daahin ilaa qafwizii dadi
hawaanan tahaa lil haqqi wal haqqu diinunaa
bi-ikhdaami zii rushdin hadaa kulla murshadi
ilaa ghayrinaa tanhul mafaasidu kulluhaa
wa tanhuu lanal khayraatu min khayri munjidi
zababtu lighayril laahi maa lam yaliq bihi
wa zabba lighayrid dahra mawlaaya hussadii
ilal laahi bil mukhtaari wajjahtu maa bihi
hawaytu zulaalan saafiyan khayra mawridi
